sourceScopeNotes.note: The Wikisource page and JSTOR record are two supplied routes to the same named 1898 Boas article; preserve both URLs without counting two distinct inspected works. Only attachment labels were read.
The supplied label identifies a thesis catalogue/abstract; do not claim full-thesis inspection from cataloguing the URL.
The URL contains a 2025 upload directory and the supplied label names an Annual Report 2024. These are owner-supplied bibliographic cues, not independently verified document or publication dates.
The public URL identifies the 477 Plan as DRAFT. Do not treat it as the current adopted plan without original-source review.
